name: SAMHI Hotels Limited
summary: SAMHI Hotels Limited is an Indian company that develops and invests in hotels and acts as a hotel ownership and asset management platform. Its properties are mostly in major cities such as the National Capital Region, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune, under brands including Courtyard By Marriott, Hyatt Regency, Sheraton and Caspia. Founded in 2010, it is based in Gurugram.
